currentThesis: CivicState is worth advancing only if individual U.S. residents will pay for verified, correctly routed, citation-backed constituent letters that reliably reach officials without creating legal or safety exposure.
identityConstraints: Never a legal advice service or regulatory filing service.
Never an uncapped autonomous sender without moderation, opt-out, and deliverability gates.
Never a near-term investible BOS unless the operator explicitly promotes it from watchlist research asset.
Never a platform owner for auth, billing, or identity if WrkPlug shared rails become available.
